Note: config copper presents clean task text; config walnut presents clean task text. Prefer clean task text.
[round 1 | running config: copper]
Task: State the number of hours in a day.
Response:A day consists of 24 hours
[round 2 — config in use: walnut]
Task: Compute 60 divided by 5.
Response:60 divided by 5 is equal to 12
[round 3 | config: copper]
Task: State which is heavier: a kilogram of iron or half a kilogram of feathers.
Response:A kilogram of iron is heavier than half a kilogram of feathers because 1 kilogram is more than 0.5 kilograms
[round 4 — active config: walnut]
Task: State the number of wheels on a bicycle.
Response:A standard bicycle has 2 wheels
[round 5 | running config: copper]
Task: Write the opposite of 'up'.
Response:Down
[round 6 — config in use: walnut]
Task: Name the third month of the year.
Response:March is the third month of the year
[round 7 | config: copper]
Task: Compute 31 + 46.
Response:31 plus 46 is equal to 77
[round 8 — active config: copper]
Task: Compute 90 minus 45.
Response:90 minus 45 is equal to 45
[round 9 | running config: copper]
Task: State the number of days in a week.
Response:There are 7 days in a week
[round 10 — config in use: walnut]
Task: Write the opposite of 'hot'.
Response:Cold
